name: Purl
summary: A progress loader that knits a striped scarf row by row while the yarn ball shrinks
about: A file export loader drawn as knitting. While the photo book is prepared, the needles work back and forth, each stitch forms in turn, the striped strip grows and sways, and the yarn ball spins and shrinks. When it finishes a heart appears in the pattern, tassels drop and a tick pops up; cancelling unravels the rows back onto the ball.
how: Press Start knitting to begin the simulated export; the percent, page count and megabytes count up
The label moves through Casting on, Knitting pages, Adding the pattern and Binding off
Press Pause and Resume at any time; the striped bar and the needles stop and start with it
Press Cancel to watch the rows unravel back onto the ball
At 100% a heart stitches itself in, tassels fall and Knit another starts over
